column1: # Keys that dotfiles-help cannot read from the config: plugin, tool and terminal keys.
# One per line: area<TAB>keys<TAB>description<TAB>doc. Lines starting with # are skipped.
# tmux keys get bind -N in tmux.conf and zsh aliases/keys an end-of-line comment in .zshrc instead.

column3: move between tmux panes and nvim splits, no prefix
save sessions now (tmux-resurrect)
restore saved sessions (tmux-resurrect)
install plugins (TPM); prefix U updates them
fzf history search
fzf: paste a file path / cd into a folder
fuzzy completion list (fzf-tab; , and . switch group)
accept the grey suggestion (zsh-autosuggestions)
jump to a frequent folder / pick one with fzf (zoxide)
clear the tmux pane in a shell, nothing in vim/nvim: sends prefix Ctrl+l (Ghostty, iTerm; Linux Ghostty: Ctrl+Shift+K)
image on the clipboard, any terminal with an ssh session: upload it to that server and paste its path; otherwise normal paste
new line in Claude Code (tmux passes it on via extended keys)
which-key lists every leader key (the leader is Space)
diff view of the working tree / history of this file / close it (diffview.nvim)
go to definition with the language server; Ctrl-o comes back
toggle light/dark
toggle Markdown rendering (render-markdown.nvim)

column2: theme toggle / pick / dark / light / auto
column3: light/dark theme; theme set nvim-light|nvim-dark <name> picks Neovim's own; theme help lists every subcommand
next / previous file, quit
stage or unstage a file
